full_details: At breakfast the hall was porridge and Tuesday's count. Twelve men at seven, and the twenty shillings already in the timber. Your mother saw the grey at your temple and did not discuss it. Edmund stays for school. At midday you read two speeches on the bench and did not touch them. In the afternoon the shop had six pairs of sheep where the order was kid. Richard said you would walk them back yourself after the frame. You wrote the prices down, and you did not add a sum of your own.
one_sentence: You stayed in the house, read the orchard sheet, and let Richard set a walk for a bundle you had miswritten.
title: Stayed in, and set a walk for the sheep skins
